newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Delta sees Hartley plant delays.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Delta sees Hartley plant delays.

text.p: Delta Gold NL said on Wednesday that delays in commissioning of a processing plant at the Hartley platinum project in Zimbabwe would not affect plans to bring the operation into full production by next June.
Delta holds a 33 percent interest in the project and The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd owns the remaining 67 percent.
Concrete thickener tanks, which form an integral part of the processing flow sheet have developed leaks, Delta said.
Commissioning of the milling concentrating and smelting facilities can commence only when the leaking tanks have been repaired, the company said.
"The delay in commissioning is not expected to be more than two months and the oepration is still on schedule to reach full production by June 1997," Delta said.
Hartley is expected to initially produce around 150,000 ounces of platinum, 110,000 ounces of palladium, 11,500 ounces of rhodium and 23,000 ounces of gold, as well as some nickel and copper.
